# Record R7

> > Record R7 is a Brazilian entertainment portal featuring Turkish and Brazilian dramas, game shows, reality TV, and exclusive behind-the-scenes content from Record network productions.

Record R7 serves as the official entertainment hub for Record TV's programming, offering comprehensive coverage of popular dramas like Coração de Mãe and Acerte ou Caia, along with interactive content including quizzes, photo galleries, videos, and celebrity interviews. The site aggregates content across multiple show formats including novelas, game shows, reality programs, and podcasts.

## Key Topics

- Record TV
- Coração de Mãe
- Acerte ou Caia
- A Escrava Isaura
- Game Shows
- Turkish Soap Opera
- Brazilian Novelas
- Celebrity Contestants
- Reality TV
- Behind-the-Scenes Content
- Dizi Cast Podcast
- Video Clips
- Character Profiles
- Entertainment News
- Interactive Quizzes

## Featured Dramas & Novelas

- [Coração de Mãe: Novela Turca](https://record.r7.com/coracao-de-mae): Turkish soap opera featuring Deniz and Karsu with compelling drama themes
- [A Escrava Isaura: Reviva a Emoção da Novela](https://record.r7.com/a-escrava-isaura): Classic Brazilian novela with drama and rich character development

## Game Shows & Competition

- [Acerte ou Caia – Game Show](https://record.r7.com/acerte-ou-caia): Game show with celebrity contestants Milena Toscano and Luiz Fara competing in quiz challenges
- [Boom! com Tom Cavalcante: Game Show Explosivo](https://record.r7.com/boom): Game show hosted by Tom Cavalcante featuring quiz and entertainment content

## Reality & Entertainment Shows

- [Casa do Patrão: Novo Reality Show da Record](https://record.r7.com/casa-do-patrao): Reality show hosted by Leandro Hassum and Boninho on Record
- [Dizi Cast: Seu Podcast de Novelas Turcas Favoritas](https://record.r7.com/dizi-cast): Dizi Cast podcast discussing Turkish dramas including Coração de Mãe

## Coração de Mãe Content Hub

- [Personagens de Coração de Mãe](https://record.r7.com/coracao-de-mae/personagens): Character profiles and guide for Turkish novela Coração de Mãe
- [Novidades de Coração de Mãe](https://record.r7.com/coracao-de-mae/novidades): Latest news and updates about Coração de Mãe novela episodes
- [Vídeos de Coração de Mãe](https://record.r7.com/coracao-de-mae/videos): Video clips and episode recaps for Coração de Mãe novela
- [Fotos de Coração de Mãe](https://record.r7.com/coracao-de-mae/fotos): Photo gallery and episode recaps for Turkish novela Coração de Mãe
- [Fora das Telas de Coração de Mãe](https://record.r7.com/coracao-de-mae/fora-das-telas): Behind-the-scenes content and cast news for Coração de Mãe
- [Quizzes de Coração de Mãe](https://record.r7.com/coracao-de-mae/quizzes): Interactive quizzes testing knowledge of Coração de Mãe characters

## Acerte ou Caia Content Hub

- [Participantes de Acerte ou Caia](https://record.r7.com/acerte-ou-caia/participantes): Participants and champions ranking for Acerte ou Caia game show
- [Novidades de Acerte ou Caia](https://record.r7.com/acerte-ou-caia/novidades): News and updates about Acerte ou Caia episodes and contestants
- [Vídeos de Acerte ou Caia](https://record.r7.com/acerte-ou-caia/videos): Video clips from Acerte ou Caia episodes and celebrity moments
- [Entrevistas de Acerte ou Caia](https://record.r7.com/acerte-ou-caia/entrevistas): Celebrity interviews with Acerte ou Caia contestants and hosts
- [Fotos de Acerte ou Caia](https://record.r7.com/acerte-ou-caia/fotos): Photo gallery from Acerte ou Caia episodes and competitions
- [Quizzes de Acerte ou Caia](https://record.r7.com/acerte-ou-caia/quizzes): Interactive quizzes based on Acerte ou Caia game show content
